preserved_hf.label: RULING (protocol wording): PRESERVED-HF's registry condition -- then its consequence
preserved_hf.question: Does the registry condition 'Chronic Heart Failure With Preserved Systolic Function' (PRESERVED-HF, NCT03030235, PMID 34711976 -- not DELIVER, which is NCT03619213) name this review's population, i.e. is 'preserved systolic function' the same as 'preserved ejection fraction' here? If yes, 'preserved systolic function' is added to the population terms of protocols/dapagliflozin-hfpef-hosp.
preserved_hf.if_yes: PRESERVED-HF passes the P5 population check; the consequence is shown next (the dapagliflozin HFpEF adverse-events notice, N09 today, no longer happens or is re-issued, per the candidate).
preserved_hf.if_no: PRESERVED-HF stays set aside; the dapagliflozin HFpEF adverse-events change stands.
